title: Water and coliform workflows
tables: Municipal water labs, rural water programs, utilities and environmental testing labs.
Culture plates/membranes can be manually counted and results arrive with limited digital traceability.
Color/RGB imaging; colony counting; controlled illumination; plate queue; barcode/PIMS; optional fluorescence.
Register sample volume/location -> execute approved membrane/plate method -> incubate -> image -> classify/count candidate colonies -> analyst confirms -> report against method criteria.
Confirmed counts per tested volume, images, colony classes, QC and location/time metadata.
Creates a scalable digital record for distributed monitoring and trend analysis.
It does not make water safe in real time. Detection limits, recovery, colony color rules, crowded membranes, confirmation tests and regulatory method equivalence must be validated.
